helpTagline.message: Let web-based AI chatbots read local files like an IDE.

helpInstallStep1.message: 1. In Chrome, open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, click “Load unpacked,” and select the extension folder.

helpInstallStep2.message: 2. (Optional) Install the native service: double-click 安装本地服务.bat in the project root and paste the extension ID when prompted.

helpInstallStep3.message: 3. Restart Chrome and open any supported AI site.

helpUsageIntro.message: A 📁 button appears in the bottom-right corner of the page (shortcut: <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+F</kbd>):

helpFileTree.message: File treeClick 📁 to open the sidebar, browse folders, and click a file to insert it into the chat input.

helpAtCommand.message: @ commandType @filename or @foldername in the chat input, then choose an item from the list.

helpNativeMode.message: Native service mode (recommended): fully automatic after installation. Requires Node.js.

helpBrowserMode.message: Browser mode: no installation required. Open the sidebar and choose a folder. Authorization is required again after restarting the browser.

helpShortcutToggle.message: <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+F</kbd> — Open or close the file panel

helpShortcutSearch.message: <kbd>@</kbd> — Start a file search in the chat input

helpUninstallNative.message: Native service: double-click 卸载本地服务.bat.
